text: BM25 is a ranking function used by search engines. It normalizes term frequency by document length.
Vector search uses embeddings to capture semantic similarity between query and document.
Hybrid ranking combines keyword and semantic scores for better retrieval quality.
Answer extraction returns the most relevant sentence from a passage.
Offline-first search stores data on device and syncs when online.
An inverted index maps terms to documents and enables fast keyword search.
Cosine similarity compares vectors to measure semantic closeness.
Stopwords are common words removed to reduce noise in search.
Chunking splits documents into passages for better matching.
Exact match and phrase match signals improve precision.
